name: @pipeworx/mcp-louisiana-code

tools.name: louisiana_statute
tools.description: Get the FULL TEXT of one section of Louisiana law by citation — Louisiana Revised Statutes ("RS 14:20" justifiable homicide, "La. R.S. 32:414" driver licence suspension), Civil Code articles ("CC 2315" liability for damages), Code of Civil Procedure ("CCP 966" summary judgment), Code of Criminal Procedure ("CCRP 701" speedy trial), Code of Evidence ("CE 404"), Children's Code ("CHC 603") and the Louisiana Constitution ("Const. Art. I, §5"). Returns the heading, statutory text, the section's enactment and amendment history ("Added by Acts 1976, No. 655; Amended by Acts 2014, No. 163") parsed into year/act pairs, and the legislature's own URL. Keyless; sourced live from the Louisiana State Legislature. Use for "what does Louisiana R.S. 14:20 say", "text of La. Civil Code art. 2315", or to check a Louisiana statute a case or contract cites.

citation.description: The citation as written: "RS 14:20", "La. R.S. 9:2800.1", "14:20" (Revised Statutes), "CC 2315" / "La. C.C. art. 2315" (Civil Code), "CCP 966", "CCRP 701", "CE 404", "CHC 603", "Const. Art. I, §5" or "CONST 1:5".

doc_id.description: Alternative to citation: the legis.la.gov document id (the d= number) returned by louisiana_law_search or louisiana_title_contents.

tools.name: louisiana_law_search
tools.description: Full-text search of Louisiana law BY TOPIC or keyword — "vehicular homicide", "security deposit lessor", "concealed handgun permit", "wrongful death damages" — across the Revised Statutes, Civil Code, Code of Civil Procedure, Code of Criminal Procedure, Code of Evidence, Children's Code and the Louisiana Constitution, optionally narrowed to chosen code bodies. Returns relevance-ranked sections with citation, heading, the date each was last modified, the total match count, and the doc_id to pass to louisiana_statute for full text. The engine ANDs every word, so two or three specific words outperform a sentence. Keyless; sourced live from the Louisiana State Legislature.

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. "vehicular homicide". Words are ANDed; "a or b" and "a not b" are understood; ""exact phrase"" in doubled quotes matches in order.

bodies.description: Law bodies to search: RS (Revised Statutes), CC (Civil Code), CCP, CCRP, CE, CHC (Children's Code), CONST, CA, HRULE, SRULE, JRULE. Default: all.

limit.description: Max results to return, default 20, max 100 (the source renders the first 100 of a larger set).

tools.name: louisiana_title_contents
tools.description: List every section in one TITLE of the Louisiana Revised Statutes with its heading and doc_id — Title 14 Criminal Law, Title 32 Motor Vehicles, Title 47 Revenue and Taxation, Title 9 Civil Code Ancillaries — optionally filtered by a word in the heading, so an agent can find the right section when a keyword search is too broad ("every section of Title 14 with 'homicide' in its heading"). Repealed sections are flagged. Keyless; sourced live from the Louisiana State Legislature's table of contents.

title.description: Revised Statutes title number, e.g. "14" (Criminal Law), "32" (Motor Vehicles), "47" (Revenue and Taxation).

filter.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to match in the section heading or citation, e.g. "homicide".

offset.description: Skip this many matching sections, default 0 — for paging through a large title.

limit.description: Max sections to return, default 50, max 200.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-louisiana-code forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the louisiana-code pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
